def sand(g):
    H,W=g.shape; g=[list(r) for r in g]
    for c in range(W):
        stack=[]
        for r in range(H-1,-1,-1):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v:
                if stack and stack[-1]<r:
                    k=r-stack[-1]-1
                    # find first empty spot at position <=stack[-1]+k? we need fill from bottom up to this cell
                    # place v just above current stack top
                    pos=stack[-1]-1
                    while pos>=0 and g[pos][c]: pos-=1
                    g[pos][c]=v
                    stack.append(pos)
                elif not stack:
                    g[r][c]=v; stack.append(r)
            else:
                pass
    return g
